title: Progressive Prop Benchmark Curriculum

provenance.interpretation: Operational sequencing and acceptance policy, not independent evidence that any capability is mastered.

governing_principle: Every prop is harder for a named reason; advance only after human acceptance of major form, proportion, components, negative space, depth, and surface quality.

capability_bootstrap.purpose: Convert reference interpretation and expert examples into transferable modeling decisions before the held-out prop ladder resumes.
diagnosed_gaps: reference evidence does not yet produce reliable three-dimensional form and assembly decisions on ordinary photographs
shape-family fitting does not yet express the local edit-mode and modifier decisions used to refine a professional cage
silhouette and technical checks underweight curvature, highlight flow, edge intent, interface quality, and editability
tutorial and blend-file observations are not yet paired with reproduction, transfer, and real-task outcome evidence
the planner can complete a step without proving coverage of every applicable visual and technical criterion

promotion_gates.name: baseline
promotion_gates.requirement: record the current system result before adding target-specific guidance

promotion_gates.name: reproduction
promotion_gates.requirement: reproduce the observed principle on neutral geometry

promotion_gates.name: transfer
promotion_gates.requirement: improve a different shape family without source geometry or copied coordinates

promotion_gates.name: adaptive_application
promotion_gates.requirement: use the principle in a live observe-decide-act-verify repair

promotion_gates.name: held_out_entry
promotion_gates.requirement: pass every required track and a blinded or human visual review without target-specific code
